title.zh: 卷71 志四十六 地理十八 臺湾
title.raw: 卷71 志四十六 地理十八 臺湾

translations.literal: Treatise 46
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 46

translations.literal: Geography 17
translations.idiomatic: Geography 17

translations.literal: Taiwan
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan

sentences.zh: 臺灣：古荒服之地，不通中國，名曰東番。

translations.literal: Taiwan: In ancient times it was a wild borderland, not connected to China, and was called the Eastern Savages.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan was in antiquity a remote border region, cut off from China, known as the Eastern Savages.

sentences.zh: 隋開皇中，遣虎賁陳棱略澎湖三十六島。

translations.literal: In the Kaihuang reign of the Sui, Tiger Guard Chen Leng subdued the thirty-six islands of Penghu.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kaihuang era of the Sui dynasty, the Tiger Guard Chen Leng was sent to subdue the thirty-six islands of the Penghu archipelago.

sentences.zh: ，海寇林道乾掠近海郡縣，都督俞大猷征之，追至澎湖，道乾遁入臺灣。

translations.literal: , the sea bandit Lin Daoqian plundered coastal commanderies and counties; Regional Commander Yu Dayou campaigned against him, pursued him to Penghu, and Daoqian fled into Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: Later the sea raider Lin Daoqian preyed on coastal commanderies and counties; Regional Commander Yu Dayou marched against him, pursued him as far as Penghu, and Daoqian escaped into Taiwan.

sentences.zh: ，閩人顏思齊引日本國人據其地。

translations.literal: , the Fujianese Yan Siqi brought Japanese to occupy the place.
translations.idiomatic: The Fujian merchant Yan Siqi then led Japanese settlers to seize the island.

translations.literal: After a long time, it was seized by the Dutch.
translations.idiomatic: In time the Dutch took it from them.

sentences.zh: ，海寇鄭成功逐荷蘭人據之，偽置承天府，名曰東都，設二縣，曰天興，曰萬年。

translations.literal: , the sea bandit Zheng Chenggong drove out the Dutch and occupied it, falsely established Chengtian Prefecture, called it the Eastern Capital, and set up two counties named Tianxing and Wannian.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel leader Zheng Chenggong expelled the Dutch and held the island, installing a bogus Chengtian Prefecture as his Eastern Capital with two counties, Tianxing and Wannian.

sentences.zh: 其子鄭經改東都為東寧省，升二縣為州。

translations.literal: His son Zheng Jing changed the Eastern Capital to Dongning Province and promoted the two counties to prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zheng Jing renamed the Eastern Capital the province of Dongning and elevated both counties to prefectural status.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十二年討平之，改置臺灣府，屬福建省，領縣三。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Kangxi it was pacified by campaign; Taiwan Prefecture was established in its place, subordinate to Fujian Province, governing three counties.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing pacified the island in Kangxi 22, reorganized it as Taiwan Prefecture under Fujian, and administered three counties.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，增置彰化縣，領縣四。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, Zhanghua County was added, and it governed four counties.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzheng 1 added Zhanghua County, bringing the prefecture to four counties.

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Guangxu, it was converted into a regular province.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxu 13 converted Taiwan into a full province.

sentences.zh: 光緒十三年九月庚午，閩浙總督楊昌濬、臺灣巡撫劉銘傳會奏，略云：「臺灣疆域，南北相距七百餘里，東西近者二百餘里，遠或三四百里，崇山大溪，鉤連高下。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the thirteenth year of Guangxu, on the day gengwu, Fujian-Zhejiang Governor-General Yang Changjun and Taiwan Governor Liu Mingchuan jointly memorialized, stating in summary: "The territory of Taiwan extends more than seven hundred li from north to south; from east to west it is a little over two hundred li in the nearer parts and in places three or four hundred li, with lofty mountains and great rivers linking high and low ground.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day in the ninth month of Guangxu 13, Governor-General Yang Changjun of Fujian-Zhejiang and Taiwan Governor Liu Mingchuan submitted a joint memorial that read in part: "Taiwan stretches over seven hundred li north to south; east to west it is two hundred li in the narrower stretches and in places three or four hundred, with great mountains and rivers knitting the terrain together.

sentences.zh: 從前所治，不過山前迤南一線，故僅設三縣而有餘。

translations.literal: What was governed in former times was no more than the single strip southward along the front of the mountains, so three counties alone were more than enough.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier administration covered only the coastal belt south of the central ranges, and three counties sufficed.

sentences.zh: 自後榛莽日開，故屢增庁治而猶不足。

translations.literal: Since then the wild thickets have been opened day by day, so sub-prefectures have repeatedly been added yet still prove insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: As the frontier has steadily opened, repeated additions of sub-prefectures have still not kept pace.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，沈葆楨請設臺北府、縣以固北路，又將同知移治卑南以顧後山，全臺官制，粗有規模。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu, Shen Baozhen requested the establishment of Taipei Prefecture and a county to secure the northern route, and also moved the sub-prefect to govern at Beinan to watch the rear mountains; the official system for all Taiwan then had a rough framework.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 1, Shen Baozhen proposed Taipei Prefecture and county to hold the north, moved a sub-prefect to Beinan to oversee the eastern ranges, and gave the island's bureaucracy a rough outline.

sentences.zh: 然彼時局勢，未聞擇要修舉，非一勞永逸之計也。

translations.literal: Yet the situation at that time did not hear of choosing essentials and carrying out thorough reforms; it was not a plan to settle matters once for all.
translations.idiomatic: Even so, the reforms of that moment were piecemeal rather than a durable settlement.

sentences.zh: 臣等公同商酌，竊謂建置之法，恃險與勢，分治之道，貴持其平。

translations.literal: Your ministers jointly deliberated and venture to say that the method of establishment relies on terrain and strategic position, while the way of divided governance values holding the balance even.
translations.idiomatic: We have consulted together and hold that administrative design must lean on terrain and strategic leverage, while divided rule must above all preserve equilibrium.

sentences.zh: 臺省治理，視內地為難，而各縣幅員，反較多於內地。

translations.literal: Governing Taiwan Province is harder than the interior, yet each county's area is on the contrary larger than in the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan is harder to govern than the mainland provinces, yet its counties are larger than most on the mainland.

sentences.zh: 如彰化、嘉義、鳳山、新竹、淡水等縣，縱橫二百餘里、三百里不等，倉卒有事，鞭長莫及。

translations.literal: Such counties as Zhanghua, Jiayi, Fengshan, Xinzhu, and Danshui extend two hundred-odd to three hundred li in length and breadth; if something arises in haste, the whip cannot reach.
translations.idiomatic: Counties such as Zhanghua, Jiayi, Fengshan, Xinzhu, and Danshui span two to three hundred li in every direction, so in a sudden crisis officials cannot respond in time.

sentences.zh: 且防務為治臺要領，轄境太廣，則耳目難周，控制太寬，則聲氣多阻。

translations.literal: Moreover, frontier defense is the essential point in governing Taiwan; if the jurisdiction is too broad, eyes and ears cannot cover it, and if control is too wide, communication is much obstructed.
translations.idiomatic: Defense is the crux of ruling Taiwan: jurisdictions that sprawl too far outrun surveillance, while overextended control blunts command and response.

sentences.zh: 至山後中、北兩路，延袤三四百里，僅區段所設碉堡，並無專駐治理之員，前寄清虛，亦難遙制。

translations.literal: As for the central and northern routes behind the mountains, stretching three or four hundred li, there are only blockhouses set in sections, with no officials stationed specifically to govern; entrusted to vacant posts in front, they are also hard to control from afar.
translations.idiomatic: The central and northern routes behind the mountains run three or four hundred li with only scattered blockhouses and no resident administrators, so even nominal oversight from the coast cannot reach them.

sentences.zh: 現當改設伊始，百廢俱興，若不量予變通，何以定責成而垂久遠？

translations.literal: Now, at the very beginning of the reorganization, a hundred neglected tasks all arise together; if we do not measure out adaptations, how can we fix responsibility and hand down a lasting order?
translations.idiomatic: With the new provincial setup just underway and every institution needing renewal, only measured flexibility can fix accountability for the long term.

sentences.zh: 臣銘傳於上年九月親赴中路督剿叛番，沿途察看地勢，並據各地方官，將境內扼塞道里、田園山溪，繪圖貼說，呈送前來。

translations.literal: Your minister Mingchuan in the ninth month of last year personally went to the central route to supervise the suppression of rebellious savages, inspected the terrain along the way, and on the basis of each local official had the strategic passes, roads and distances, fields, gardens, mountains, and streams within the borders drawn in maps with explanatory notes and forwarded.
translations.idiomatic: Last ninth month your servant Liu Mingchuan led the central-route campaign against rebel tribes, surveyed the terrain en route, and collected from local officials illustrated maps of passes, roads, farmland, and waterways throughout the jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 又據撫番清賦各員弁將撫墾地所陸續稟報，謹就山前後通局籌畫，有應添設者，有應改設者，有應裁撤者。

translations.literal: Also on the basis of successive reports from the various officers pacifying the savages and clearing tax registers on the lands they brought under cultivation, we respectfully take the overall situation before and behind the mountains and plan: some offices should be added, some changed, and some abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Reports from pacification and land-tax officers on newly opened settlements allow us to plan comprehensively for both the western plains and the eastern ranges, recommending additions, revisions, and abolitions of posts.

sentences.zh: 查彰化橋孜圖地方，山環水複，中開平原，氣象宏敞，又當全臺適中之地，擬照前撫臣岑毓英議，就該處建立省城，分彰化東北之境設首府曰臺灣府，附郭首縣曰臺灣縣，將原有之臺灣府、縣改為臺南府安平縣。

translations.literal: Investigating the place at Qiaozitu in Zhanghua, mountains surround it and waters fold back, with a plain opened in the center and a grand, expansive aspect, and it also lies at the center of all Taiwan; we propose following the former Governor Cen Yuying's plan to establish the provincial capital there, divide the northeastern territory of Zhanghua to set a capital prefecture called Taiwan Prefecture, with the attached capital county called Taiwan County, and change the original Taiwan Prefecture and county to Tainan Prefecture and Anping County.
translations.idiomatic: At Qiaozitu in Zhanghua, encircled by hills and streams, a broad central plain sits at the island's geographic heart; following Governor Cen Yuying's earlier proposal we would place the provincial capital there, carve from northeastern Zhanghua a new Taiwan Prefecture with Taiwan County as its seat, and rename the old prefecture and county Tainan Prefecture and Anping County.

sentences.zh: 嘉義之東，彰化之南，自濁水溪至姑石圭溪止，截長補短，方長四百餘里，擬添設一縣曰云林縣。

translations.literal: East of Jiayi and south of Zhanghua, from the Zhuoshui River to the Gushigui River, trimming long and supplementing short, the square area is more than four hundred li; we propose adding one county called Yunlin County.
translations.idiomatic: Between Jiayi to the east and Zhanghua to the south, from the Zhuoshui River to the Gushigui River—a tract of roughly four hundred square li—we propose a new Yunlin County.

sentences.zh: 新竹苗栗街一帶，扼內山之衝，東連大湖，沿山新墾荒地甚多，擬於新竹西南各境添設一縣曰苗栗縣，合原有之彰化，及埔里社通判，一庁、四縣，均隸臺灣府屬。

translations.literal: The belt around Miaoli Street in Xinzhu commands the passes into the inner mountains, links east to Dahu, and has much newly opened waste land along the mountains; we propose adding one county called Miaoli County in the various districts southwest of Xinzhu; together with the original Zhanghua and the Puli sub-prefect, one sub-prefecture and four counties would all be subordinate to Taiwan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Miaoli Street district of Xinzhu guards the mountain passes, connects eastward to Dahu, and holds extensive new hillside reclamation; we would add Miaoli County in southwestern Xinzhu, so that with Zhanghua and the Puli sub-prefect the new Taiwan Prefecture would govern one sub-prefecture and four counties.

sentences.zh: 其鹿港同知一缺，應即裁撤。

translations.literal: The one post of sub-prefect at Lukang should be abolished at once.
translations.idiomatic: The Lukang sub-prefect post should be eliminated immediately.

sentences.zh: 淡水之北，東控三貂嶺，番社歧出，距縣太遠。

translations.literal: North of Danshui, controlling the Sandiao Ridge to the east, savage villages branch out in many directions and lie too far from the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: North of Danshui, where the Sandiao Ridge commands the east, aboriginal settlements sprawl so far from the county yamen that they cannot be governed effectively.

sentences.zh: 基隆為臺北第一門戶，通商建埠，交涉紛繁，現值開採煤礦，修造鐵路，商民麕集，尤賴撫綏。

translations.literal: Keelung is the foremost gateway of northern Taiwan; with trade ports opened, negotiations are numerous; now coal mines are being opened and railways built, merchants and people gather in crowds, and pacification is especially relied upon.
translations.idiomatic: Keelung is Taipei prefecture's chief port: treaty commerce, constant foreign dealings, coal mining, railway construction, and throngs of merchants all demand stronger local administration.

sentences.zh: 擬分淡水東北四堡之地，撤歸基隆庁管轄，將原設通判改為撫民理番同知，以重事權。

translations.literal: We propose dividing off the territory of the four forts in northeastern Danshui, withdrawing it to the jurisdiction of Keelung Sub-prefecture, and changing the originally established sub-prefect to a sub-prefect for pacifying the people and managing the savages, to strengthen administrative authority.
translations.idiomatic: We would detach the four northeastern forts of Danshui to Keelung sub-prefecture and upgrade the existing sub-prefect to a Pacification and Savages sub-prefect with broader powers.

translations.literal: This is the general outline of additions and changes on the front routes.
translations.idiomatic: Such is the outline of reforms for the western districts.

sentences.zh: 後山形勢，北以蘇溪為總隘，南以卑南為要區，控扼中權，厥惟水尾。

translations.literal: The terrain behind the mountains has Suxi as the chief pass in the north and Beinan as the key sector in the south; to hold the central leverage, none other than Shuiwei.
translations.idiomatic: Behind the mountains, Suxi forms the northern barrier, Beinan the southern anchor, and Shuiwei the pivot that commands the whole eastern flank.

sentences.zh: 其地與擬設之雲林縣東西相直，現開路百九十餘里，由丹社嶺集集街經達彰化，將去省城，建立中路，前後脈絡，呼吸相通，實為臺東鎖鑰。

translations.literal: That place lies directly east-west across from the proposed Yunlin County; a road of more than one hundred ninety li is now being opened from Danshe Ridge and Jiji Street through to Zhanghua, approaching the provincial capital; establishing the central route, front and rear connect in pulse and breath, and it is truly the lock and key of eastern Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: It lies due east of the proposed Yunlin County; a road of nearly two hundred li now links Danshe Ridge and Jiji Street to Zhanghua and the future provincial capital, tying the island's east and west together as the key to all Taiwan east of the ranges.

sentences.zh: 擬添設直隸州知州一員曰臺東直隸州，左界宜蘭，右界恆春，計長五百餘里，寬約四十里、十餘里不等，統歸該州管轄，仍隸於臺灣兵備道。

translations.literal: We propose adding one direct-administration prefectural magistrate called Taidong Direct Administration Prefecture; on the left it borders Yilan, on the right Hengchun; the length is reckoned at more than five hundred li, the width about forty li or more than ten li in varying parts, all placed under that prefecture's jurisdiction, still subordinate to the Taiwan military defense circuit.
translations.idiomatic: We propose a new directly governed prefecture, Taidong, bounded by Yilan on the west and Hengchun on the south—about five hundred li long and between ten and forty li wide—still under the Taiwan military defense intendant.

sentences.zh: 其卑南庁舊治，擬請改設直隸州同一員。

translations.literal: The old seat of Beinan Sub-prefecture is proposed to be changed to establish one sub-prefect of the direct-administration prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The former Beinan sub-prefect seat would become a sub-prefect under the new Taidong prefecture.

sentences.zh: 水尾迤南，改為花蓮港庁。

translations.literal: South of Shuiwei, it is changed to Hualian Harbor Sub-prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: South of Shuiwei the district would be reorganized as Hualian Harbor sub-prefecture.

sentences.zh: 其內已墾熟田約數千畝。

translations.literal: Within it, fields already opened and brought to maturity amount to several thousand mu.
translations.idiomatic: Several thousand mu of land there have already been cleared and brought under cultivation.

sentences.zh: 其外海口水深數丈，稽查商舶，彈壓民番，擬請添設直隸州判一員，常川駐紮，均隸臺東直隸州屬。

translations.literal: Outside, the estuary is several zhang deep in water, inspecting merchant vessels and suppressing settlers and savages; we propose requesting the addition of one direct-administration prefectural judge, stationed there permanently, all subordinate to Taidong Direct Administration Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Its harbor mouth is several zhang deep, suited to inspecting merchant shipping and keeping settlers and tribes in order; we would add a permanently stationed prefectural judge subordinate to Taidong.

translations.literal: This is the general outline of additions behind the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Such is the outline of reforms for the districts behind the mountains.

sentences.zh: 謹按臺灣疆土賦役，日增月廣，與舊時羈縻僑置情形迥不相同，因地制宜，似難再緩。

translations.literal: Respectfully considering Taiwan's territory, land tax, and labor service, they grow day by day and month by month, utterly unlike the former situation of loose control and nominal placement; adapting measures to local conditions seems hard to delay further.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan's territory, taxes, and corvée obligations expand steadily, in a condition wholly unlike the old era of nominal control; reforms tailored to local realities can scarcely wait.

sentences.zh: 況年來生番歸化，狉榛之性初就範圍，尤須分道拊循，藉收實效。

translations.literal: Moreover, in recent years raw savages have submitted, their wild and uncouth nature first coming within bounds, and it is especially necessary to pacify them by separate routes to gather real effect.
translations.idiomatic: As more aboriginal tribes submit and their formerly untamed ways begin to yield to law, separate channels of supervision are needed to make pacification effective.

sentences.zh: 輯遐牖邇，在在需員，臣等身在局中，既不敢遇事紛更，以紊典章之舊，亦不敢因陋就簡，以失富庶之基，損益酌中，期歸妥協。

translations.literal: To gather the distant and enlighten the near, everywhere officials are needed; your ministers, being within the situation, dare neither change matters rashly and disorder the old statutes, nor cling to the crude and simple and lose the foundation of wealth, but weigh increase and decrease and seek the middle, hoping to reach a proper settlement.
translations.idiomatic: Bringing distant regions under order and prosperity requires officials at every point; we who stand in the midst of these affairs dare neither alter institutions rashly and unsettle precedent, nor settle for makeshift simplicity and forfeit Taiwan's growing wealth, but seek a balanced compromise.

translations.literal: " In the twenty-first year, it was ceded and placed under Japan.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twenty-first year of Guangxu it was ceded to Japan.

sentences.zh: 省在福建東南五百四十里。

translations.literal: The province lies five hundred forty li southeast of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: The province lies five hundred forty li southeast of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 西北距京師七千二百五十里。

translations.literal: To the northwest it is seven thousand two hundred fifty li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Northwestward it is seven thousand two hundred fifty li from Beijing.

translations.literal: On the east it borders the sea;
translations.idiomatic: Its eastern border is the sea;

translations.literal: on the west it borders Penghu Island;
translations.idiomatic: on the west Penghu Island;

translations.literal: on the south it borders Jitou Sea;
translations.idiomatic: on the south Jitou Sea;

translations.literal: on the north it borders the sea at Keelung city.
translations.idiomatic: on the north the sea off Keelung.

sentences.zh: 廣五百里，袤一千八百里。

translations.literal: It is five hundred li wide and one thousand eight hundred li long.
translations.idiomatic: It measures five hundred li across and one thousand eight hundred li from end to end.

sentences.zh: 一統志載戶口原額人丁一萬八千八百二十七，滋生男婦大小口共一百七十八萬六千八百八十三，戶二十二萬四千六百四十六。

translations.literal: The Comprehensive Gazetteer records the original quota of registered males at 18,827; males and females of all ages born and growing total 1,786,883; households 224,646.
translations.idiomatic: The Comprehensive Gazetteer lists an original registered male quota of 18,827, a total population of 1,786,883 men, women, and children, and 224,646 households.

sentences.zh: 領府三，州一，庁三，縣十一。

translations.literal: It governs three prefectures, one department, three sub-prefectures, and eleven counties.
translations.idiomatic: It comprised three prefectures, one department, three sub-prefectures, and eleven counties.

sentences.zh: 臺灣屹峙海中，為東南屏障，四面環海，崇山峻岭，橫截其中，背負崇岡，襟帶列島。

translations.literal: Taiwan stands towering in the sea as the southeastern barrier; on all four sides it is encircled by sea; lofty mountains and steep peaks cut across its midst; it backs onto high ridges and clasps a chain of islands at its breast.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan rises from the sea as the southeastern rampart of the empire, ringed by ocean, cut by towering ranges, backed by high hills, and girdled by archipelagoes.

sentences.zh: 浪嶠南屏，雞籠北衛，澎湖為門戶，鹿耳為咽喉。

translations.literal: Langjiao screens the south, Jilong guards the north, Penghu is the gateway, and Luer is the throat.
translations.idiomatic: Langjiao forms the southern screen, Jilong the northern bastion, Penghu the gateway, and Luer the throat.

sentences.zh: 七鯤身毗連環護，三茅港匯聚澄泓。

translations.literal: The Seven Kun Shen lie linked in ringed protection, and Sanmao Harbor gathers clear, deep waters.
translations.idiomatic: The Seven Kun Shen islets chain together in protective embrace, while Sanmao Harbor pools clear, deep water.

translations.literal: The abundance of livestock and pasturage is no different from the central lands.
translations.idiomatic: Its livestock and pasture are as rich as those of the mainland.

translations.literal: It is truly a great metropolis of the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Truly it was a great metropolis of the southeast.

translations.literal: Taiwan Prefecture: strategically vital, commercially bustling, fiscally strained, and difficult to govern.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan Prefecture: strategically vital, commercially bustling, fiscally strained, and difficult to govern.

translations.literal: It is the seat of Taiwan Province.
translations.idiomatic: It served as the provincial capital of Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 巡撫、布政使、分巡兵備道兼按察使銜，共駐。

translations.literal: The governor, provincial administration commissioner, and the circuit intendant for military defense with concurrent surveillance commissioner rank were all stationed together.
translations.idiomatic: The governor, provincial treasurer, and the military defense intendant with concurrent surveillance duties were all stationed there.

sentences.zh: 其地東及東南界臺東州；

translations.literal: Its territory on the east and southeast borders Taidong Department;
translations.idiomatic: To the east and southeast it bordered Taidong Department;

translations.literal: on the west and north it borders the sea;
translations.idiomatic: to the west and north the sea;

translations.literal: on the south and southwest it borders Tainan Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: to the south and southwest Tainan Prefecture;

translations.literal: on the northeast it borders Taipei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: to the northeast Taipei Prefecture.

translations.literal: The figures for width and length in li are missing.
translations.idiomatic: Its dimensions in li are not recorded.

sentences.zh: 北極高二十四度三十三分。

translations.literal: North polar altitude: 24 degrees 33 minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its latitude is 24°33′ north.

translations.literal: East of the capital meridian by 4 degrees 20 minutes.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 4°20′ east of the Beijing meridian.

translations.literal: It governed four counties and one sub-prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It governed four counties and one sub-prefecture.

translations.literal: Taiwan County: strategically vital, commercially bustling, fiscally strained, and difficult to govern.

sentences.zh: 濁水出埔里社庁東南山，西南流，左合二水，經雲林縣東北，一水自南來注之。

translations.literal: The Zhuoshui River rises from the southeastern mountains of Puli Sub-prefecture, flows southwest, on the left joins two streams, passes the northeast of Yunlin County, and one stream from the south enters and joins it.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhuoshui rises in the southeastern hills of Puli sub-prefecture, flows southwest, receives two tributaries on the left, passes northeastern Yunlin County, and is joined by a stream from the south.

translations.literal: It bends north, on the right receives one stream, and passes north of the county.
translations.idiomatic: It bends northward, takes in a tributary on the right, and runs along the county's northern border.

sentences.zh: 又西北，一水自嘉義縣來，北流注之。

translations.literal: Again northwestward, one stream comes from Jiayi County and flows north to enter it.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northwest a stream from Jiayi County flows north to join it.

sentences.zh: 又西經牛埔厝，歧為三支：一支曰石龜溪，西為牛椆溪；

translations.literal: Again west it passes Niupucuo and divides into three branches: one branch is called Shigui Stream, westward becoming Niuchou Stream;
translations.idiomatic: West of Niupucuo it splits into three branches: one is Shigui Stream, which becomes Niuchou Stream to the west;

sentences.zh: 一支曰虎尾溪，經汕頭厝為麥藔港，並經縣西入于海；

translations.literal: one branch is called Huwei Stream, passes Shantoucuo as Mailiao Harbor, and both pass west of the county to enter the sea;
translations.idiomatic: one is Huwei Stream, which passes Shantoucuo as Mailiao Harbor and reaches the sea west of the county;

sentences.zh: 一支為東螺溪，又歧為三，曰刺桐港即番挖港，曰鹿港，曰二林港，並經彰化縣西入于海。

translations.literal: one branch is the Dongluo Stream, which again divides into three, called Citong Harbor—that is, Fanwa Harbor—Lukang, and Erlin Harbor, all passing west of Zhanghua County to enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: one is the Dongluo Stream, which divides again into Citong Harbor (also called Fanwa Harbor), Lukang, and Erlin Harbor, all entering the sea west of Zhanghua County.

sentences.zh: 大肚溪上源曰合水溪，出埔里社庁東南魚池仔，西北流，合南硿溪，經庁西北，北港溪、北硿溪並西流注之。

translations.literal: The upper source of the Dadu River is called Heshui Stream, rising at Yuchizi southeast of Puli Sub-prefecture, flowing northwest, joining Nankeng Stream, passing northwest of the sub-prefecture; Beigang Stream and Beikeng Stream both flow west to enter it.
translations.idiomatic: The Dadu River's upper course is the Heshui Stream, rising at Yuchizi in southeastern Puli, flowing northwest to join the Nankeng Stream; the Beigang and Beikeng streams enter it from the west below the sub-prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又西，珠子山二水合西北流注之，經府治南，左右各納一水，經大肚街為大肚溪，又西北入于海。

translations.literal: Again west, two streams from Zhuzi Mountain join and flow northwest to enter it; it passes south of the prefectural seat, on left and right each receives one stream, passes Dadu Street as the Dadu River, and again northwest enters the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Westward, two streams from Zhuzi Mountain unite and flow northwest into it; south of the prefectural seat it takes tributaries on both sides, becomes the Dadu River at Dadu Street, and enters the sea to the northwest.

sentences.zh: 大甲溪出苗栗縣東南，合數小水，西南流，右出支津注於吞霄溪。

translations.literal: The Dajia River rises in southeastern Miaoli County, joins several small streams, flows southwest, and on the right sends out a branch canal that enters Tunxiao Stream.
translations.idiomatic: The Dajia River rises in southeastern Miaoli, gathers several brooks, flows southwest, and sends a branch canal on the right into the Tunxiao Stream.

sentences.zh: 正渠南流，左納一水，折西北，經鐵砧山南，又西北入于海。

translations.literal: The main channel flows south, on the left receives one stream, turns northwest, passes south of Tiezhen Mountain, and again northwest enters the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Its main channel flows south, takes a tributary on the left, turns northwest past Tiezhen Mountain, and reaches the sea.

sentences.zh: 吞霄溪出苗栗縣東南，合大甲溪支津，經縣南，西北流入于海。

translations.literal: The Tunxiao Stream rises in southeastern Miaoli County, joins the branch canal of the Dajia River, passes south of the county, and flows northwest into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Tunxiao Stream rises in southeastern Miaoli, receives the Dajia branch canal, runs south of the county, and flows northwest into the sea.

sentences.zh: 後壠溪出苗栗縣東南山，合一水，西北流，經五鶴山，南至鋼羅灣，夾二洲，又西北，經縣治北，右通中港溪，左納一水，入于海。

translations.literal: The Houlong Stream rises from the southeastern mountains of Miaoli County, joins one stream, flows northwest, passes Wuhu Mountain, south to Gangluo Bay, between two islets, again northwest, passes north of the county seat, on the right connects with Zhonggang Stream, on the left receives one stream, and enters the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Houlong Stream rises in Miaoli's southeastern hills, joins a tributary, flows northwest past Wuhu Mountain to Gangluo Bay between two sandbars, then northwest past the county seat, links on the right with the Zhonggang Stream, takes a tributary on the left, and enters the sea.

sentences.zh: 中港溪出縣東山，緣界西北流，經縣治，左出支津合後壠港支水為烏眉溪，與正渠並西北入于海。

translations.literal: The Zhonggang Stream rises from the eastern mountains of the county, flows northwest along the border, passes the county seat, on the left sends out a branch canal joining the branch water of Houlong Harbor as Wumei Stream, and together with the main channel both enter the sea northwestward.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhonggang Stream rises in the county's eastern hills, flows northwest along the border past the seat, sends a left branch that joins Houlong Harbor's waters as the Wumei Stream, and reaches the sea together with the main channel.

translations.literal: The Niuchou Stream rises east of Jiayi County, flows northwest, passes north of the seat, and together with Buduizui Harbor both flow west into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Niuchou Stream rises east of Jiayi, flows northwest past the county seat, and with Buduizui Harbor enters the sea to the west.

sentences.zh: 八掌溪出雲林縣界，西北流，經平鼻山北半月山，南合瀵箕湖及一小水，西流至鹽水港，入于海。

translations.literal: The Bazhang Stream rises on the border of Yunlin County, flows northwest, passes north of Pingbi Mountain and Banyue Mountain, on the south joins Fenji Lake and one small stream, flows west to Yanshui Harbor, and enters the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Bazhang Stream rises on the Yunlin border, flows northwest past Pingbi and Banyue mountains, gathers Fenji Lake and a brook from the south, and reaches the sea at Yanshui Harbor.

sentences.zh: 急水溪二源，並出雲林縣西界，經嘉義縣東南，合西流，又經急水鋪南，左納十八重溪，又經鐵線橋街北，又西入于海。

translations.literal: The Jishui Stream has two sources, both rising on the western border of Yunlin County, passing southeast of Jiayi County, joining and flowing west, again passing south of Jishui Post, on the left receiving Shibazhong Stream, again passing north of Tiexianqiao Street, and again west entering the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Jishui Stream's two headwaters rise on Yunlin's western border, unite southeast of Jiayi, flow west past Jishui Post, take in Shibazhong Stream on the left, pass north of Tiexianqiao Street, and enter the sea.

sentences.zh: 曾文溪出府治東北，西北流，經大武壠北，右納茄拔溪，左納一小水，經府治北，又西經倒風港，入于海。

translations.literal: The Zengwen Stream rises northeast of the prefectural seat, flows northwest, passes north of Dawulao, on the right receives Jiaba Stream, on the left receives one small stream, passes north of the prefectural seat, again west passes Daofeng Harbor, and enters the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Zengwen Stream rises northeast of the prefectural seat, flows northwest past Dawulao, takes Jiaba Stream on the right and a brook on the left, runs north of the seat, passes Daofeng Harbor, and reaches the sea.

sentences.zh: 柴頭港出府治東北山，西北流，經治北，又西合德慶港為安平港，入于海。

translations.literal: Chaitou Harbor rises from the northeastern mountains of the prefectural seat, flows northwest, passes north of the seat, again west joins Deqing Harbor as Anping Harbor, and enters the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Chaitou Harbor rises in the hills northeast of the seat, flows northwest, joins Deqing Harbor to form Anping Harbor, and enters the sea.

sentences.zh: 二層行溪出府治東，茄定港出雁門關嶺，阿公店溪出鳳山縣東北，並西流入于海。

translations.literal: Ercengxing Stream rises east of the prefectural seat; Jiading Harbor rises at Yanmenguan Ridge; Agongdian Stream rises northeast of Fengshan County; all flow west into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Ercengxing Stream rises east of the seat; Jiading Harbor rises at Yanmenguan Ridge; the Agongdian Stream rises northeast of Fengshan County; all reach the sea to the west.

sentences.zh: 淡水溪出府治東六張犁，西南流，右納一水，左納二水，經下淡水西，鳳山縣治東，至潮州厝汛北，西冷水溝水出縣東芋匏山，合二水西南流注之。

translations.literal: The Danshui Stream rises at Liuzhangli east of the prefectural seat, flows southwest, on the right receives one stream, on the left receives two streams, passes west of Xiadanshui and east of the Fengshan county seat, to north of Chaozhoucuo Post; the Lengshuigou Stream westward rises east of the county at Yupao Mountain, joins two streams flowing southwest to enter it.
translations.idiomatic: The Danshui Stream rises at Liuzhangli east of the seat, flows southwest taking tributaries on both sides, passes west of Xiadanshui and east of Fengshan seat to north of Chaozhoucuo Post, where the Lengshuigou Stream from Yupao Mountain joins with two brooks and enters from the west.

sentences.zh: 又西南匯為東港，入於港海。

translations.literal: Again southwest it gathers as Donggang and enters the harbor sea.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southwest it forms Donggang and enters the coastal waters.

sentences.zh: 茄藤港在鳳山縣南，西流入于海。

translations.literal: Qieteng Harbor lies south of Fengshan County and flows west into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Qieteng Harbor lies south of Fengshan County and flows west into the sea.

sentences.zh: 率芒溪出恆春縣北武吉山，合一水，西流入于海。

translations.literal: The Shuaimang Stream rises at Wuji Mountain north of Hengchun County, joins one stream, and flows west into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Shuaimang Stream rises at Wuji Mountain north of Hengchun, joins a tributary, and flows west into the sea.

sentences.zh: 刺桐港、楓港、五重溪、三重港、射寮溪並在恆春縣北，西流入于海。

translations.literal: Citong Harbor, Feng Harbor, Wuzhong Stream, Sanzhong Harbor, and Sheliao Stream are all north of Hengchun County and flow west into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Citong Harbor, Feng Harbor, the Wuzhong Stream, Sanzhong Harbor, and Sheliao Stream all lie north of Hengchun and flow west into the sea.

sentences.zh: 龍鑾潭在恆春縣南，西北流入于海。

translations.literal: Longluantan lies south of Hengchun County and flows northwest into the sea.

sentences.zh: 大隆洞溪出基隆庁東雞籠山，合一水西流注之。

translations.literal: The Dalongdong Stream rises at Jilong Mountain east of Keelung Sub-prefecture, joins one stream flowing west to enter it.
translations.idiomatic: The Dalongdong Stream rises at Jilong Mountain east of Keelung, joins a western tributary, and enters the main stream.

sentences.zh: 又西北，分流復合，經扈尾港入于海。

translations.literal: Again northwest, it divides and reunites, passes Huwei Harbor, and enters the sea.
translations.idiomatic: It turns northwest, divides and reunites, passes Huwei Harbor, and enters the sea.

sentences.zh: 南崁港上流為大過溪，在府治西北。

translations.literal: The upper reach of Nankan Harbor is the Daguo Stream, northwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Nankan Harbor's upper course is the Daguo Stream, northwest of the seat.

sentences.zh: 中瀝溪、土牛溝、紅毛港、鳳山崎溪、舊港、油車港、香山港並在新竹縣西北入于海。

translations.literal: Zhongli Stream, Tuniugou, Hongmao Harbor, Fengshanqi Stream, Jiugang, Youche Harbor, and Xiangshan Harbor all enter the sea northwest of Xinzhu County.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhongli Stream, Tuniugou, Hongmao Harbor, Fengshanqi Stream, Jiugang, Youche Harbor, and Xiangshan Harbor all reach the sea northwest of Xinzhu County.

sentences.zh: 三貂溪在基隆庁東南，草嶺大溪、加禮遠港、蘇澳門並在宜蘭縣南，俱入于海。

translations.literal: Sandiao Stream lies southeast of Keelung Sub-prefecture; Caoling Daxi, Jiali Yuan Harbor, and Suao Gate all lie south of Yilan County and all enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Sandiao Stream lies southeast of Keelung; the Caoling Daxi, Jiali Yuan Harbor, and Suao Gate all lie south of Yilan County and enter the sea.

translations.literal: Taidong Direct Administration Prefecture: strategically vital, commercially bustling, fiscally strained, and difficult to govern.
translations.idiomatic: Taidong Direct Administration Prefecture: strategically vital, commercially bustling, fiscally strained, and difficult to govern.

translations.literal: Reorganized from Beinan Sub-prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Established by reorganizing Beinan sub-prefecture.

translations.literal: Five hundred li northwest of the provincial seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay five hundred li northwest of the provincial capital.

translations.literal: On the east and south it borders the sea;
translations.idiomatic: To the east and south the sea;

translations.literal: on the west and northwest it borders Taiwan Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: to the west and northwest Taiwan Prefecture;

translations.literal: on the north it borders Taipei Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: to the north Taipei Prefecture;

translations.literal: on the southwest it borders Tainan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: to the southwest Tainan Prefecture.

translations.literal: The figures for width and length in li are missing.
translations.idiomatic: Its dimensions in li are not recorded.

sentences.zh: 北極高二十二度二十五分。

translations.literal: North polar altitude: 22 degrees 25 minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its latitude is 22°25′ north.

translations.literal: East of the capital meridian by 4 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 4° east of the Beijing meridian.

translations.literal: Beinan, where the department sub-prefect was stationed.
translations.idiomatic: A department sub-prefect was posted at Beinan.

translations.literal: Hualian Harbor, where the department judge was stationed.
translations.idiomatic: A department judge was posted at Hualian Harbor.

sentences.zh: 其山在州境者，北：岐來山、能高山。

translations.literal: Mountains within the department's territory: north—Qilai Mountain and Nenggao Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Mountains within the department: in the north, Qilai and Nenggao Mountains.

translations.literal: West: Xiuguluan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: West: Xiuguluan Mountain.

translations.literal: East: Dingxiang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: East: Dingxiang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西出八同關，為秀姑巒山一帶番社，系屬巒番所居。

translations.literal: Westward it exits at Batong Pass; the savage villages along Xiuguluan Mountain belong to the Luan tribes who dwell there.
translations.idiomatic: To the west it passes Batong Pass into the tribal settlements along Xiuguluan Mountain, home to the Luan peoples.

sentences.zh: 西南一帶高山番社，系屬昆番所居。

translations.literal: The high-mountain savage villages in the southwestern belt belong to the Kun tribes who dwell there.
translations.idiomatic: The highland tribal settlements in the southwest are inhabited by the Kun peoples.

sentences.zh: 大港上源曰打馬溪，出秀姑巒山，東流經治北，右合網網溪，左合一水，經奇密社北，入于海。

translations.literal: The upper source of Dagang is called Dama Stream; it rises from Xiuguluan Mountain, flows east past north of the seat, on the right joins Wangwang Stream, on the left joins one stream, passes north of Qimi Village, and enters the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Dagang's upper course is the Dama Stream, rising from Xiuguluan Mountain, flowing east past the seat's north, joining Wangwang Stream on the right and a brook on the left, passing north of Qimi Village, and reaching the sea.

sentences.zh: 卑南大溪出州西南新武洛社，合三水東南流入于海。

translations.literal: The Beinan Daxi rises at Xinwuluo Village in the southwest of the department, joins three streams, and flows southeast into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Beinan Daxi rises at Xinwuluo Village in the department's southwest, gathers three tributaries, and flows southeast into the sea.

sentences.zh: 花蓮港二源，並出州西北，合數小水，經太平廠南入于海。

translations.literal: Hualian Harbor has two sources, both rising in the northwest of the department, joining several small streams, passing south of Taiping Factory, and entering the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Hualian Harbor's two headwaters rise in the department's northwest, gather several brooks, pass south of Taiping Factory, and enter the sea.

sentences.zh: 東澳、南澳、大濁水溪、大清水溪、小清水溪、得其黎溪、三棧溪、尤丹溪、米侖港並在州東北，入于海。

translations.literal: Dongao, Nanao, Dazhuoshui Stream, Daqingshui Stream, Xiaoqingshui Stream, Dedeli Stream, Sanzhan Stream, Youdan Stream, and Milun Harbor are all in the northeast of the department and enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Dongao, Nanao, the Dazhuoshui, Daqingshui, and Xiaoqingshui streams, the Dedeli, Sanzhan, and Youdan streams, and Milun Harbor all lie in the department's northeast and reach the sea.

sentences.zh: 紅蝦港、黎仔阬溪、郎阿郎溪、馬武窟溪、八里芒溪、呂家望溪、知本溪、大苗里溪、虷子侖溪、大足高溪、-{干}-子壁溪、大烏萬溪、巴塱衛溪、魯木鹿溪、牡丹灣、八磘灣並在州東南，入于海。

translations.literal: Hongxia Harbor, Lizikeng Stream, Langalang Stream, Wuwuku Stream, Balimang Stream, Lujiawang Stream, Zhiben Stream, Damiaoli Stream, Haozilun Stream, Dazugao Stream, Ganziibi Stream, Dawuwan Stream, Balangwei Stream, Lumulu Stream, Mudan Bay, and Badian Bay are all in the southeast of the department and enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Hongxia Harbor, the Lizikeng, Langalang, Wuwuku, Balimang, Lujiawang, Zhiben, Damiaoli, Haozilun, Dazugao, Ganziibi, Dawuwan, Balangwei, and Lumulu streams, together with Mudan Bay and Badian Bay, all lie in the department's southeast and reach the sea.
